text_content:
Program

Translate Claire Hughes Johnson's Scaling People into Sŏn's operating structure and systems, chapter by chapter. The book is a guide, upstream of Sŏn's own thinking, not foreign material to translate.

The tracker doc is the single source of truth for how this program runs: 2ky45bmy-17233. Read its protocol block before every session. This task description is a pointer, not a duplicate, so the two cannot drift.

The one-line frame

Her ask → what Sŏn already holds (from V7 and canon) → the gap → the decision.

The team

Three profiles, live in Box, folder 400727361228. Loaded by chapter ownership, not all at once.
Organizational Systems Architect (2352980282301): her Ch1, Ch2, the progression structure.
People Systems Designer (2353165009738): her Ch3, Ch4, Ch5.
Hospitality Operations Realist (2353380918688): cross-cutting tempo test.

Cold-start

New chat, attach both PDFs (book + workbook), paste:

Sŏn. Scaling People, session [N]. ClickUp task [ID]. Begin.

The session reads its brief, its carryovers, the context ledger, the profiles its chapter needs, and the named V7 and canon sections, then works. Full sequence and the definition of done are in the tracker protocol.

What sessions produce

Decisions and specifications, written to the Sŏn Operating System doc (2ky45bmy-17253). Never instruments; instrument production is gated on the document methodology (86ajgn2z5).

The four protocols that make this survivable over weeks

All detailed in the tracker:
Context ledger: a short running-state section read at the start of every session and updated at the end. The anti-drift mechanism across 20+ sessions. The chat is disposable; the ledger is the memory.
Tangent protocol: when a non-linear thread surfaces, the session names it (carryover / pull now with a park / research now-or-later), recommends, and Brandon decides. Nothing held loose in a chat.
Pause and resume: "pausing here" writes state to the ledger, files loose thoughts as carryovers, and confirms the next action. Resuming reads the ledger, never the chat.
Token discipline: load by ownership, read by page range, carry state in the ledger not the chat, one session per chat.

Standing rules

Customer never guest. No em dashes. No performed conviction. Declarative over aspirational. Sentence case. No daypart code names. No financial figures; from Airtable (appKHeje63inr1fLG) or absent. Profanity spoken-only.
